item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's teacher asks her to measure the temperature of hot water in a beaker during a class experiment.
Which thermometer should Meena choose?

options.A: a clinical thermometer, because it is used in a school
options.B: a laboratory thermometer, because it is used to measure the temperature of objects other than the human body
options.C: a non-contact infrared thermometer, because it measures temperature from a distance
options.D: any thermometer with a number display, because all thermometers measure the same range
